seo.title: The Audacity · Agentic Engineering Studio
seo.description: An Agentic Engineering Studio. Your product live in weeks at a fixed price, from €6k. Price and deadline go in the contract before any code. Book a call.

hero.headline: Your product live in weeks, at a fixed price
hero.lede: We build the whole product: sign-up and login, database, and launch on the web or app stores, with payments and analytics when you need them. The price and deadline go in the contract before any code, and you pay per finished milestone.
hero.priceLine: From €6k for a 2 to 3 week Pilot. Every price is on this page.

proofTeaser.title: Proof starts with three products of our own
proofTeaser.body: Three products we built ourselves and one pilot at a gym. Each card says what it is and where it stands. Client work follows as it ships.

process.title: Three steps take your idea from agreed scope to production

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: We agree one outcome, a price and a deadline before any code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: You see working software early and often, and you sign off each milestone before you pay for it. AI agents do the build. Senior judgment owns architecture, security and code review.

steps.title: Ship
steps.body: Your product goes live in production with automatic releases, ready for real users.

ctaBand.title: Tell us the idea that should already be live
ctaBand.body: In a 45-minute diagnostic call we tell you what it takes to ship it and whether we are the right studio. A written fixed-price proposal follows within 2 business days. The call is €175 until 30 November (normally €250), and the fee comes off the project price if you go ahead.

seo.title: Work · Bloop, Washiiba, Kerf and Recovery Room · The Audacity
seo.description: Bloop, an AI concierge app for events in your city. Washiiba, a full marketplace platform. Kerf, a case study on public LiDAR data. Recovery Room, a gym booking pilot.

hero.headline: Three products of our own show how we build
hero.lede: Bloop is an AI concierge app that finds events and things to do in your city. Washiiba is a full marketplace platform. Kerf is a case study that turns public LiDAR data into work orders. Recovery Room is a booking pilot, live at a gym in Cagliari. The first three are our own products. Each section lists what we built, its status and what it shows.

cta.title: Bring the product you want live in weeks
cta.body: Book a 45-minute diagnostic call for €175 until 30 November (normally €250). The fee comes off the project price if you go ahead. A written fixed-price proposal follows within 2 business days.

hero.headline: Book a call. Tell us what you want to ship.
